resources.scope: Execution interval only. Discrete samples, not continuous hardware peaks. rss includes worker descendants; own_gpu_memory is the supervisor-selected worker PID only. Other PIDs are observed co-residency, not proof of causation or ownership. Card CSV is index,uuid,name,freeMiB,totalMiB,utilization. artifact_bytes measures the entire shared run tree and must not be summed across lines.

model_calls.scope: Resident attempts include local status-400 context responses, not external HTTP traffic. Generated responses include later protocol/environment errors. staff_done/wait are controls, not world actions. Prompt-token totals repeat history and are not unique-token counts. No token arrays re-exported.

control_representation_difference.representation: Assistant message.content is JSON with kind=wait, finish_reason=stop and no structured tool_calls. The saved runtime accepted this as model_control.

stop_causality.meaning: One whole-machine GPU query exceeded 10 seconds; process query succeeded. Guard immediate-stop rule terminated own worker. Legacy label after handover is not evidence that the authorized 18-hour task budget expired.

stop_causality.primary_trigger: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device
stop_causality.follow_on_validation_error: Current actor event differs from its actual world receipt
stop_causality.outer_worker_error: Unknown outcome or frozen evaluation state mismatch
stop_causality.meaning: R1 update already complete. Temporary-file creation failed, then receipt trust check made the confirmation unknown. Unknown is not a zero reward.

resource_measurement_limits.rss_scope: Supervisor RSS includes worker descendants; own GPU memory is selected worker PID; card total includes all users and device overhead.
resource_measurement_limits.artifact_scope: Each artifact sample measures an entire run tree; do not sum stage peaks within a run or count pre-existing weights as new artifacts.
resource_measurement_limits.co_residency_scope: Other PIDs establish concurrent residency only, not ownership, causal slowdown, or a cause of telemetry timeout.
